title: X-LAB DAWNBREAKER Dura-Ace Di2 specification
notes: Official mainland specification for the Dura-Ace Di2 build: 8.83 kg without pedals in size L; the same frame, fork, cockpit and seatpost as the R7170 build; Dura-Ace Di2 R9160 shift buttons, R9180 brake levers and R9250 derailleurs, FC-R9200 54/40T and CS-R9200 11–34T; Vision Metron 91 front and Metron TTW disc rear wheels; Michelin Pro 5 700×28C tires. The official bicycle listing shows this build at CNY 108,000.
